layers.name: NY State Thruway Toll Gantries
layers.description: This dataset provides information about the locations where toll gantries cross over the Thruway Authority's Roadways. A single record is provided for at each location, even if there are two gantries (e.g., one over the westbound direction of travel, and one over the eastbound). The gantries are used to determine tolls for vehicles that pass under them. They contain E-ZPass tag readers and cameras and sensors to bill non-E-ZPass users via Cashless Tolling.

nttaWebMapItem.title: Toll Rates Web Map - NTTA.org
nttaWebMapItem.description:
NTTA Toll Rates Web Map used on the NTTA.org page (https://www.ntta.org/roadsprojects/rates/Pages/Toll-Rates.aspx)

TollTag rates are 15.3 cents per mile effective July 1, 2011 as part of a the NTTA toll rate setting policy adopted in 2009. ZipCash rates are 50 percent more than the TollTag rates, reflecting the higher costs of collection. This policy follows a schedule that requires toll rates to be increased every other July at a compounded annual rate of 2.75 percent. NTTA rates are consistent with the toll rate structure recommended by the Regional Transportation Council.


 Helpful Links and Information 

  • Toll Rates - Individual ramp and main lane gantry toll rates for each road.
  • Trip Calculator Charts - Determine the total cost of your trip from entrance to exit.
  • Toll Rate FAQs - Find answers to frequently asked questions about toll rates.
  • Where Do My Tolls Go? - Discover the impact  your toll dollars have on North Texas
  • Customer Information - Two ways to pay your tolls with cashless tolling.
